subject: Medford Square Historic Zoning Incentives
overview: The commission reviewed historic preservation incentives and potential review conflicts within the newly approved Medford Square zoning. Members also received updates on ongoing preservation projects, archaeological surveys, and Tufts University's revised swimming pool design before approving past meeting minutes.

items.title: Medford Square Zoning and Historic Resources
items.summary: Doug Carr outlined new zoning provisions granting design review and dimensional waivers to incentivize preserving historic structures in Medford Square, while Ryan Hayward raised concerns about legal conflicts between the zoning text and the city's existing demolition delay bylaws.

items.title: Commission Vacancies and Appointments
items.summary: Members discussed open seats and checked the progress of swearing in newly appointed member Luke.

items.title: Section 106 and Project Updates
items.summary: Hayward provided updates on Section 106 reviews, tree removal and planned radar studies at Thomas Brooks Park, and conservation work at Cross Street Cemetery and Hastings Heights.

items.title: Brooks Estate Parking and Cemetery Expansion
items.summary: Carr reported on public pushback regarding planned parking and cemetery expansion at the Brooks Estate, with members discussing long-term financial viability and conservation easements.

items.title: Tufts University Swimming Pool Design Revisions
items.summary: Carr presented updated architectural renderings for the Tufts swimming pool featuring sawtooth windows and a glass vestibule, noting plans to seek historical interpretive signage for the site.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the previous meeting minutes.
